jonas: Heads-up — Prospect (NovaCare) is pressing for SOC2 attestation + a signed pen-test letter inside 2 weeks and wants a single-tenant POC. Legal says NDA is signed but they insisted on earlier evidence. Any way to meet this or do we ask for an exception?
amelia: Quick Q: do they need a full Type II report or just the attestation/letter + artifacts?
jonas: They specifically asked for an attestation letter and a signed pen-test letter. They said budget is tight and would like the signed pen-test included during POC if possible.
mike-security: We can provide a signed pen-test attestation from our assessor, but standard turnaround is ~3 weeks after we schedule. Faster is possible but it's an expedited service (cost + 3–5 business days).
amelia: For POCs we usually ship right away: SOC2 summary + control matrix + network diagram + a recent external scan export. Signed pen-test letter is typically after paid engagement unless they pay for expedited attestation.
sara-ops: Pricing note: expedited signed pen-test add-on is ~$7k one-time (partner fee) and requires a kickoff window. Private POC setup fee (VPC + isolation) is $2.5k. Reserved-month estimate (if they go dedicated) is ~ $8.5k for the month — I can formalize.
evidence-bot: Ticket CPL-2026 created for NovaCare evidence request — owner: amelia — https://internal/tickets/CPL-2026 (placeholder)
mike-security: Alternative mitigation we can propose now: 1) immediate delivery of SOC2 attestation summary + control matrix and network diagram, 2) run an external scan during the POC and share results, 3) contract clause committing to deliver a signed pen-test letter within 30 days of a paid reserved commitment. This reduces risk and keeps the POC moving.
jonas: Customer is asking for an exception to the 30-day signed-letter condition. They're willing to move to reserved capacity if we can deliver the signed letter earlier. I'm thinking: offer artifacts now + optional expedited signed letter for the fee. Thoughts?
amelia: That sounds reasonable. I'll draft a response. Can someone paste the exact artifact list we can ship today so I can include it?
mike-security: Artifact list we can ship immediately:
```
- SOC2 attestation letter (summary PDF)
- Control matrix (CSV)
- Network diagram (PDF)
- External scan report (exported findings)
- Pen-test letter (signed only if expedited add-on paid, otherwise unsigned template)
```
sara-ops: I'll prepare a short quote with line items: expedited pen-test add-on $7,000, private POC setup fee $2,500, 1-month reserved estimate $8,500. Also flag: expedited turnaround requires scheduling window from assessor; earliest delivery 4 business days after payment.
jonas: Perfect — I will send the proposal to NovaCare and CC legal. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
amelia: Adding: include the standard indemnity and redaction process note — we redact sensitive customer findings before sharing.
jonas: Good call. Closing this thread once I hear back from the customer.
